findings.name: Guerrier
findings.text: What legendary place have you always wanted to visit, and why is it so special?

findings.name: Guerrier
findings.text: We knew each other long before this party came together. How?

findings.name: Guerrier
findings.text: What mundane task do you usually help me with off the battlefield?

findings.name: Guerrier
findings.text: What fear am I helping you overcome?

findings.name: Magicien
findings.text: What responsibilities did your community once count on you for? How did you let them down?

findings.name: Magicien
findings.text: You've spent your life searching for a book or object of great significance. What is it, and why is it so important to you?

findings.name: Magicien
findings.text: You have a powerful rival. Who are they, and why are you so determined to defeat them?

findings.name: Magicien
findings.text: What favor have I asked of you that you're not sure you can fulfill?

findings.name: Magicien
findings.text: What weird hobby or strange fascination do we both share?

findings.name: Magicien
findings.text: What secret about yourself have you entrusted only to me?

findings.name: Sorcière
findings.text: Who from your community feared your magical craft? What rumor did they spread about you, and what truth did it contain?

findings.name: Sorcière
findings.text: You once used your power to help someone in a dire situation. Who were they, and why did they come to you?

findings.name: Sorcière
findings.text: Your magic once opened a door best left closed. Who or what was on the other side?

findings.name: Sorcière
findings.text: What unique ritual or practice have I taught you that we now perform together?

findings.name: Sorcière
findings.text: I once appeared to you in a dream and shared a vision of the future. What did I tell you?

findings.name: Sorcière
findings.text: What do you typically come to me for advice about?

findings.name: Roublard
findings.text: What did you get caught doing that got you exiled from your home community?

findings.name: Roublard
findings.text: You used to have a different life, but you've tried to leave it behind. Who from your past is still chasing you?

findings.name: Roublard
findings.text: Who from your past were you most sad to say goodbye to?

findings.name: Roublard
findings.text: What did I recently convince you to do that got us both in trouble?

findings.name: Roublard
findings.text: What have I discovered about your past that I hold secret from the others?

findings.name: Roublard
findings.text: Who do you know from my past, and how have they influenced your feelings about me?

findings.name: Occultiste
findings.text: Who from your community shunned you after you made a pact with your patron?

findings.name: Occultiste
findings.text: What desperate situation led you to pledge your life to your patron?

findings.name: Occultiste
findings.text: Your patron has given you one task you must accomplish above all else. What is it, and why does it worry you?

findings.name: Occultiste
findings.text: Why do you think I confide in you about what my patron says and does?

findings.name: Occultiste
findings.text: Our relationship has changed since you saw me show tribute to my patron. What did you see, and how has it affected you?

findings.name: Occultiste
findings.text: I once did something very foolish, and you've never let me live it down. What was it?

findings.name: Ensorceleur
findings.text: What did you do that made the people in your community wary of you?

findings.name: Ensorceleur
findings.text: What mentor taught you to control your untamed magic, and why are they no longer able to guide you?

findings.name: Ensorceleur
findings.text: You have a deep fear you hide from everyone. What is it, and why does it scare you?

findings.name: Ensorceleur
findings.text: Why do you trust me so deeply?

findings.name: Ensorceleur
findings.text: What did I do that makes you cautious around me?

findings.name: Ensorceleur
findings.text: Why do we keep our shared past a secret?

findings.name: Barde
findings.text: Who from your community taught you to have such confidence in yourself?

findings.name: Barde
findings.text: You were in love once. Who did you adore, and how did they hurt you?

findings.name: Barde
findings.text: You've always looked up to another bard. Who are they, and why do you idolize them?

findings.name: Barde
findings.text: What made you realize we were going to be such good friends?

findings.name: Barde
findings.text: What do I do that annoys you?

findings.name: Barde
findings.text: Why do you grab my hand at night?

findings.name: Bagarreur
findings.text: Where did you spend time during your formative years that taught you, directly or indirectly, how to fight in the style you use?

findings.name: Bagarreur
findings.text: What organization has vowed to kill you on sight, and what did you do to invoke their ire?

findings.name: Bagarreur
findings.text: Who did you recently lose a fight to that you're desperate for a rematch against?

findings.name: Bagarreur
findings.text: What is one thing we're both afraid of?

findings.name: Bagarreur
findings.text: What do I rely on you for during our travels? How do you feel about it?

findings.name: Bagarreur
findings.text: I still haven't forgiven you for something you said to me. What was it, and why did you say it?

findings.name: Gardien
findings.text: Who from your community did you fail to protect, and why do you still think of them?

findings.name: Gardien
findings.text: You've been tasked with protecting something important and delivering it somewhere dangerous. What is it, and where does it need to go?

findings.name: Gardien
findings.text: You consider an aspect of yourself to be a weakness. What is it, and how has it affected you?

findings.name: Gardien
findings.text: How did I save your life the first time we met?

findings.name: Gardien
findings.text: What small gift did you give me that you notice I always carry with me?

findings.name: Gardien
findings.text: What lie have you told me about yourself that I absolutely believe?

findings.name: Druide
findings.text: Why was the community you grew up in so reliant on nature and its creatures?

findings.name: Druide
findings.text: Who was the first wild animal you bonded with? Why did your bond end?

findings.name: Druide
findings.text: Who has been trying to hunt you down? What do they want from you?

findings.name: Druide
findings.text: What did you confide in me that makes me leap into danger for you every time?

findings.name: Druide
findings.text: What animal do I say you remind me of?

findings.name: Druide
findings.text: What affectionate nickname have you given me?

findings.name: Séraphin
findings.text: Which god did you devote yourself to? What incredible feat did they perform for you in a moment of desperation?

findings.name: Séraphin
findings.text: How did your appearance change after taking your oath?

findings.name: Séraphin
findings.text: In what strange or unique way do you communicate with your god?

findings.name: Séraphin
findings.text: What promise did you make me agree to, should you die on the battlefield?

findings.name: Séraphin
findings.text: Why do you ask me so many questions about my god?

findings.name: Séraphin
findings.text: You've told me to protect one member of our party above all others, even yourself. Who are they and why?

findings.name: Rôdeur
findings.text: A terrible creature hurt your community, and you've vowed to hunt them down. What are they, and what unique trail or sign do they leave behind?

findings.name: Rôdeur
findings.text: Your first kill almost killed you, too. What was it, and what part of you was never the same after that event?

findings.name: Rôdeur
findings.text: You've traveled many dangerous lands, but what is the one place you refuse to go?

findings.name: Rôdeur
findings.text: What friendly competition do we have?

findings.name: Rôdeur
findings.text: Why do you act differently when we're alone than when others are around?

findings.name: Rôdeur
findings.text: What threat have you asked me to watch for, and why are you worried about it?
